nom: The Crème Shop Hello Kitty and Friends Bright Yuzu Jelly Overnight Mask

avis.texte: so tbh i bought this cause im a kuromi girl and the packaging was hard to resist. but i have veryyyy dry sensitive skin, like most products just make me break out immediately, this didnt!! and for some reason recently, my skin had been extra dry. like to the point of it cracking and being painful, this really has helped soothe it and hydrate those dry spots a lot.
I love this overnight mask, super light on your skin and doesn't affect my skin at all. Really easy to apply and will use every night!
This product is heavily scented which makes me doubt the efficacy of it. Not sure that I would recommend putting it on your face.

I've tried so many face masks and can honestly say this is one of my favorites! It was easy to sleep in and had my face so glowy in the morning! I have really dry skin but this helped so much in making my skin soft! Definitely recommend if you're looking for a new mask!

This is good night time mask. I love that's lightly fragrant while still being light. The only thing I dont like is how the stickiness never fully dries on my face but that's just a texture thing with me. I do feel like my face is brighter and looks more moisturized the next day!
This face mask makes my face unbelievably soft! I love the consistency and feeling it has on my skin and would absolutely recommend to everyone!

avis.titre: This product is so cute and super hydrating
avis.texte: This is super cool the product is every thick but super refreshing I put it in the fridge for that cold refreshing feeling. I really enjoyed it and would definitely recommend and it has a nice smell but nothing too strong .

I've been using this overnight mask for a couple weeks now when I go to bed (not every night but a few times a week) and I can't say it did much for the acne I have on my chin (there was a little difference) but it did help with my dry skin so if you have dry skin I'd recommend this product because only after a few uses I noticed a significant difference in my face. Really hydrating mask. If you're looking for something that helps with acne this might not be the product for you or maybe it might be since everyone's skin is different and what doesn't work for me might work for you. Also smells really good. Do I think the price is worth it? 50/50 on that since like I said it didn't really help with my acne that much.
I feel like my face felt refreshed! Loved the container it came in as well!

avis.titre: Hello Kitty and Friends Bright Yuzu Overnight Mask
avis.texte: This mask really helped smooth my skin and made my face look brighter. It also helped fade some of my dark spots. Simple but effective!

As instructed, after cleansing my face. I applied the mask before going to bed. I was hesitant it would stay put all night, but surprisingly my skin absorbed it while still leaving a brightening effect until the follow morning. No stickiness or flaking off. I did notice that it didn't wear well underneath my foundation, but on its own the mask worked great. My skin felt tighter and brighter!

The mask is super moisturizing. I've been using it every night for a few weeks. It's really helped with the skin barrier. I get flaky patches on my skin so having this has been great. It absorbs well and doesn't leave residue all over the pillow. I'd definitely recommend!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: After around 2 weeks of using this product, I can feel that my skin is smoother and brighter. It has been added to my nightly routine, I pair it up with facial massages: the consistency of the product makes it easy to work with. In the morning, when I wash my face its smooth and bright, so far it hasnt caused me any pimples. It kind of controls my oilyness but not for the whole day. I would recommend using it everyday to see consistent results.

I have always been skeptical of the idea of an overnight mask, because I always thought that it would never be as effective as peel mask. This mask not only had drastic results, it's so carefree. I'd say it took about 2 weeks before I noticed how even my skin was getting. Overall, I am definitely going to continue using this mask until it's empty, and will surely by a new one after.
Application of the yuzu mask is easy and results are visible fast! Would buy again!
I loved how moisturizing this product felt when putting on! I would recommend this product!

avis.titre: I wake up with soft, hydrated skin everytime I use this mask
avis.texte: I received the Hello Kitty and Friends Bright Yuzu Overnight Mask for free from the brand through the BzzAgent sampling program in exchange for my honest review. I've been applying this mask as the last step in my evening skincare routine. The gel-cream texture feels lightweight and absorbs quickly, so it's comfortable to sleep in and doesn't leave residue on my pillow. Each morning after using it, my skin feels softer, more hydrated, and looks refreshed. The citrusy yuzu scent is light and pleasant, and the Hello Kitty packaging makes it extra fun to use. What I like most is that it delivers overnight hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. It's especially nice when I want my skin to look more plump and awake the next day. The only drawback is that those who dislike fragrance or have very dry skin might find it less suitable, since it's more lightweight than deeply rich masks. Overall, this overnight mask makes my skincare routine more enjoyable and leaves my skin feeling healthier and more refreshed in the morning.
I love the packaging, it was one of the big draw ins for me but on top of that the mask is really hydrating and feels great on the skin.

This overnight face mask is super cute and makes me wake up with plump and hydrated skin. The gel consistency is perfect to wear to bed without feeling weighed down or greasy. The product seems to absorb nicely into my skin and allows me to wake up with plump skin. This product is great for those with dry skin or who use drying products also at night such as prescription trentinoin. The smell was not bad but it was one that I had to get used to over several nights. I usually prefer fragrance free products but the smell was nice and light.

The Hello Kitty & Friends Bright Yuyu overnight mask was given to me for free in exchange for my honest Review. I had never heard of Hello Kitty having a beauty line for adults before receiving this product! How cool is that! The bottle itself is so cute, girly & def can be kept for other uses once you use all the product. This overnight mask goes on smoothly and perpetrates your skin, not just sit on top of your skin like some products do, so i felt like it was working as soon as I rubbed it in. The scent is very light, non fragrance and doesn't linger on your skin all night and day. Its not runny but not overly thick, just the right consistency imo! I used this as a overnight mask a few nights and my skin felt softer and looked brighter after the first use. Def gets better with consistent use. After a few nights I used it as my nighttime moisturizer a few times as in i applied less and didn't wash off. I think both ways work just as well! I'm kinda excited to look into what other Hello kitty beauty product are on the market in this line now! My mother used some from my bottle one night and she's now ordered herself a bottle! I would ded recommend this if your looking to brighten and soften your skin a little bit.

I love this packaging a lot, it is so cute and vibrant. I like the mask is thin and like a jelly material because it is able to stick to my face well, and I do feel like it comes with enough product in it for its price, so I am pleased with it and I would say to use it weekly. I do not like that when you are washing off the mask because my face squeaks because of the jelly like texture so thats annoying but it does brighten
I have used this product multiple times over the past week and love the way it makes my skin feel. It's a wonderful consistency and isn't heavily scented so I don't mind sleeping with it on!

I've been using it for a little over a week now, and I love how it makes my skin feel the next morning— it feels and looks more hydrated. I would say it's works somewhat better than the Elf Holy Hydration Gel-Yeah Moisturizer which is the product I was using previously. All in all, I'm very satisfied with the product and plan to continue using it as part of my nightly skincare routine. I love the packaging, it's so cute and perfect for the hello kitty lovers.

avis.titre: love this product in every way !!
avis.texte: This mask is so cute but also super effective! The gel texture feels really light and refreshing when I put it on, and it's not sticky at all which makes it perfect for overnight. I wake up with my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and a little extra glowy. The light yuzu scent is fresh without being overwhelming, and the Hello Kitty packaging makes my skincare routine way more fun. Definitely a new favorite in my nighttime routine!

This is so unique and so good! I'm in love with the effects of this! First, the texture is gel, and feels so good. In soaks into my skin well, absolutely very quickly, it leaves my skin looking and feeling way better than before. My skin has never felt this great! My skin is so soft and just so soft, like " velvet "just this our of this world texture that I can't get enough of. My akin is bright and stunning looking when I wake up. (I even use it during the day because the experience and feel of my skin is addictive! This is by far the best product out there for skin! Hands down.

avis.titre: Glow up with a touch of the Hello kitty Overnight Mask
avis.texte: The Hello Kitty® and Friends Bright Yuzu Overnight Mask is a lightweight, non-sticky gel that leaves your skin feeling hydrated, refreshed, and visibly brighter by morning. Its gentle formula, cute packaging, and effective results make it a fun and reliable addition to any skincare routine. I'd definitely buy it again and recommend it to friends or family looking for a glow boost.

I don't normally use scented products, but this one has just the right amount and isn't too strong. Adorable, durable packaging. A little goes a long way and the container holds a lot of products. Feels moisturizing when applying. It does dry down after about 30-45 minutes. Skin remained bright and even while using it nightly.

I read the instructions to the mask and did as it said too. I did notice that it absorbed very well into my skin and the product didn't have a scent at all. It absorbed nicely , I would use this as a night time moisturizer maybe not everyday but every once in awhile.
I am really enjoying the results of using this mask, my skin looks rejuvenated and healthy!

I used this overnight mask and first off, it feels really good on the skin and has a nice subtle scent to it. The texture is nice and I wake up to my skin feeling refreshed and brightened. I usually have dry skin and wake up to flakiness on my skin, but using this hydrates my skin very well.

This overnight mask is such a fun yet effective skincare pick. It has a gel-like consistency that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy residue, which I love for an overnight mask. The packaging is absolutely adorable—I already know I'm keeping the box even after I finish the product. There's also a subtle fragrance to it that feels refreshing but not overpowering, making it a great bedtime companion.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product leaves my face so nice and bright, would definitely recommend

avis.titre: i love this stuff, and the packaging is chefs kiss
avis.texte: I love this face mask, its very soothing and makes me feel refreshed, not to mention the cute packaging almost reminding me of pink lemonade. my only dislike is the scent isn't super pleasant but smells clean! this product was sent to me for free in return of a review!!
This product made my face feel more alive in the morning once I wash it off , it makes my face feel very soft and moisturized.

avis.titre: I am in love with the design
avis.texte: This is amazing when i first apply it on. It is so moisturizing and washed off easily in the morning. I love how it leaves my skin soft and hydrated. Feel cool to wear and does not irritate skin. Love it

avis.titre: It's so soft and I. Love the feeling absorbs well
avis.texte: This mask is so moisturizing and feels so good on my skin. It absorbs very quickly and smells so good. I leave it on overnight and wake up glowing.

First time trying this Hello Kitty and Friends Overnight Mask so far I'm loving the result this overnight mask have great texture it smell good the packaging is super cute easy to open and close. When applied to my skin is just melt woke up in the morning my skin looking refreshing it's not greasy. Amazing ingredients like Yuzu Extract and vitamin E which helps create evenly toned brighter complexion. This is my new favorite overnight Mask from now on.

I received this as a free sample and have been using it for a couple days now and its nice. Its very jelly like (but not as structures as jello, which is good in my opinion) which gives it a slight cooling effect. It has a slight fragance of yuzu/citrus which is pleasant. Its moisturizing though its not very heavy as one would expect for being an overnight moisturizer.

I've been struggling with acne scars for a few months, so I've been using the overnight mask every night for about a week. I enjoy the gel consistency; it's not too thick but still very hydrating. I've noticed my skin has gotten brighter, and the acne scars are starting to lighten. It has a citrusy scent to it, which I find refreshing. Overall, I'm impressed with the short-term results and am excited to see the effects with long-term use.

This mask absorbs into my skin really quickly and gives me an instant glow. I wake up my skin feels very hydrated. Its a gel texture not to thick it's perfect, I have oily skin. I can't wait too see brighten results over time.

I received this item for free from BzzAgent for my honest opinion in review. I was so excited to find out I was chosen for this trial. My daughter was too. She loves Hello Kitty. The box came and everything was so nicely put together. The packaging is so cute. The mask was very easy to apply, not heavy at all. The scent was very subtle. Which I found very delightful I found the mask to be extremely Hydrating and brightening. It left my face feeling refreshed. Not oily at all. I was very impressed. I will be buying more. I will be recommending.
I loved the way it looks and the way it also works as a brighter for your skin I loved it very much

I originally thought this package was a collaboration product, so its packaging would be the only appealing thing, but I found myself pleasantly surprised! The texture is clear and lightweight, and not really sticky. Since I use tretinoin at night, I like to lather this on my face last, and in the morning, I feel like my skin is a lot more moisturized and not dry. My makeup pills are less due to my dry skin from tretinoin. The yuzu scent is not too strong and resembles a generic hand soap scent.

avis.titre: Leaves skin glowy and hydrated, great formula!
avis.texte: I use this a couple of times a week after washing my face and it's great. My skin loves the gel-like consistency... it kind of reminds me of an aloe vera gel but it has a really smooth feeling to it. When I wake up my skin is hydrated and glowy which I absolutely love!! LG Beauty kindly gave me this Hello Kitty® and Friends Bright Yuzu Overnight Mask for free so that I could review it.

avis.titre: Glowing Skin with a Cute Touch
avis.texte: This Hello Kitty and Friends Bright Yuzu Overnight Mask is so cute and refreshing. The citrus scent is light and pleasant, the cream feels soft on the skin, and I wake up with a brighter and more hydrated face. The packaging is adorable and it makes skincare fun.

The packaging is so cute. The scent is light, fresh, and citrusy without being overpowering, and it instantly makes me feel refreshed. The formula is super nourishing, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin soft and glowing. I've noticed it gives me a nice brightness and hydration boost, which makes it perfect for everyday use.

I was skeptical about this product at first, but it shocked me! I noticed a big difference in the brightness of my face after washing it off the next morning. It feels cooling on the skin, which feels great after coming in from this Summer heat! It was a little odd sleeping it it, as I am a stomach sleeper… but overall I would highly recommend this product! You won't be disappointed

I really enjoyed using the Hello Kitty® and Friends Bright Yuzu Overnight Mask. The packaging is super cute, and the scent is light and refreshing without being overwhelming. It left my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and a little brighter in the morning. I wouldn't say it's a miracle product overnight, but with consistent use, I definitely noticed a healthy glow. Overall, it's fun, gentle, and worth trying if you like skincare that feels both effective and adorable.

Holy cow, this is the best mask I've tried. Usually I don't enjoy mask because my skin tends to reject it and makes my pores worse. But this one I can tell it's help so much and it doesn't feel sticky like most of them. I definitely recommend this product
